query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Check & fix styling

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**.php'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  php-code-styling:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref }}

      - name: Fix PHP code style issues
        uses: aglipanci/laravel-pint-action@2.6

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v7
        with:
          commit_message: Fix styling

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Bound jobs with a custom timeout

Pattern: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (job_timeout)

When is bound jobs with a custom timeout applicable?

Assess bound jobs with a custom timeout for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Representative successful-duration history exists

Contraindications: Valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit

Method: Choose an explicit budget with operational headroom; Measure false timeout failures separately

Reported finding: Custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 12.9, "paid": 8.1}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.6; Table 4; PDF pp. 7, 8: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf
